author: Adobe Creative Cloud
description:
Learn how to turn a single #AdobeStock image into multiple assets that match your brand's aesthetic perfectly!

@AlexeiDelaCuesta breaks down his workflow using Adobe Stock AI Studio, from changing the color, editing the type, swapping the background, to even animating the image.  

This is a game-changer for creatives! Especially when you have tight deadlines and budgets but still need to deliver scroll-stopping content fast. 

Do you plan on trying this out for yourself? Let us know in the comments.
